title: KNOuX Applications — the software command surface
question: The KNOuX visual world is fixed. This round chooses only the composition of the Applications workspace. The roll leads with the register.

options.label: The Live Register
options.lineage: Windows Control Panel 'Programs and Features' raised to a dossier-grade ledger
options.thesis: One continuous ledger of installed software, where selecting a program opens its dossier in that row's own place.
options.viewport: Command strip and facet bar, then a dense publisher-grouped ledger with the selected program's dossier band expanded inline.
options.risk: A wide table goes flat unless the icon column and the expanded band carry real contrast.

regions.label: command strip: inventory search + live counts
expanded dossier band (icon, identity, size, source, controls)

options.label: The Staging Deck
options.lineage: batch software managers and a freight manifest
options.thesis: Selection is a queue, not a highlight: chosen programs collect in a staging tray that carries the next action.
options.viewport: Facet rail, inventory field, dossier column, and a persistent staging tray pinned across the bottom of the workspace.
options.risk: The tray promises batch operations the backend cannot yet perform, so it must carry review actions only.

regions.label: dossier column for the focused program
staging tray — selected programs queue here

options.label: The Coverage Ribbon
options.lineage: instrument readout panels and data-coverage charts
options.thesis: The workspace opens by declaring how much it actually knows about this machine, then shows the collection under it.
options.viewport: A measured coverage band (icons, sizes, dates, publishers known) above filter chips, with the collection and its dossier split below.
options.risk: A meta-metric over the content can read as a dashboard instead of a software library.

regions.label: coverage ribbon — what the inventory really knows
